selected_script.angle: Freeing up cutting board prep area by relocating heavy bottles and hanging utensils to the refrigerator side wall
selected_script.hook: Stop running out of cutting board space because of cluttered condiment bottles and tangled kitchen tools.

script_record.0-3s: Handheld phone-shot showing a home cook slicing vegetables on a cutting board, accidentally knocking over a heavy oil bottle and a pair of scissors due to lack of space.
script_record.3-6s: A matte black metal magnetic spice rack is attached firmly to the refrigerator side, and the bottle is placed inside while the scissors are hung from the detachable bottom hooks.
script_record.6-10s: Close-up shot of the rack holding the heavy bottles securely without slipping.
script_record.10-14s: Side angle view showcasing the clean metal texture of the rack with oven mitts hanging neatly from the bottom hooks.
script_record.14-18s: A wide shot showing the organized, clean cutting board area with the cook prepping food smoothly.
script_record.18-20s: Screen displays the CTA text: 'Upgrade your kitchen prep space today.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, 9:16 aspect ratio, realistic handheld phone-shot style. Use the provided product reference image as the exact product identity: a matte black carbon steel rectangular tray rack with a high flat back plate, a lower front retaining wall, and detachable metal hooks hanging from the bottom edge. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life pain scene where a person is prepping food on a crowded cutting board and accidentally knocks over a heavy oil bottle and kitchen shears due to clutter. 3-6s: Introduce the product by mounting it firmly on the metal refrigerator side wall, immediately placing the heavy bottle inside and hanging the shears on the bottom hooks. 6-10s: Show a stable close-up of the rack holding the items secure without slipping. Do not include any CTA in this segment. Do not use any extra accessories. Keep the product style consistent.
